Weather Tight Hatch RM-36 - Common Alarm

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
			deck_slide_wind_drive_fail__value AS deck_slide_wind_drive_fail,
			w_tight_hatch_rm_35_commonalarm__value AS wt_hatch_rm35_alarm,
			w_tight_hatch_rm_36_commonalarm__value AS wt_hatch_rm36_alarm,
			wtsd_mainbackuppwrfail__value AS wtsd_pwr_fail,
			sos_lock_supply_14_e_11_fail__value AS sos_lock_supply_fail1,
			sos_lock_supply_14_e_12_fail__value AS sos_lock_supply_fail2,
			sos_lock_supply_14_e_13_fail__value AS sos_lock_supply_fail3,
			haz_consumers_emergstopactive__value AS em_stop_haz_cons_active
FROM marpower__090000_doors_hatches
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(CASE
							WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('HATCH_ANCHOR_SENSOR1_OPEN') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							ELSE NULL
					END) AS anchor_hatch1_open_tag,
			MAX(CASE
							WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('HATCH_ANCHOR_SENSOR2_OPEN') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							ELSE NULL
					END) AS anchor_hatch2_open_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/090000-doors-hatches'

SELECT timestamp AS time,
			wtid_tech_room_access_door__value AS tech_room_door,
			tech_room_esc_hatch_ps_open__value AS tech_room_esc_hatch_open,
			tech_corridor_esc_hatch_sb_open__value AS tech_corr_esc_hatch_open,
			wtid_fwd_corridor_door_open__value AS fwd_corr_door_open,
			wtid_aft_corridor_door_open__value AS aft_corr_door_open
FROM marpower__090000_doors_hatches
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1
